messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty trigger -> high 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (prod-usw2). error_rate=18% over 1m, threshold=5%. Incident INC1234567. Autopage enabled.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC1234567 assigned to oncall-sre-jamie (primary). Notify: eng-platform-sana.

oncall-sre-jamie: Acked. I'm on it. First check: is this regional or global? @eng-platform-sana can you surface kvcache evictions + pod restarts in us-west2?

eng-platform-sana: Looking — seeing a spike in prefix/KV cache evictions and repeated 502s from embedding-service:v2-quant in prod-usw2. QPS steady but latency spikes before evictions. Scaling the embedding pool + increasing cache memory on the next rollout.

support-ops-ryan: Customer reports: firstTier saw 5 customers with errors (timeouts/502). Opening support tickets and adding to the incident notes. Preparing a short status update.

oncall-sre-jamie: Quick mitigation: diverting ~20% of traffic to fallback-emb-small in prod-usw2 and enabling stricter retry-backoff on the gateway for embeddings routes. Will monitor for 5m.

ops-lead-matt: If scaling doesn't dampen, we should consider cordoning the oldest nodes and draining pods to force healthy replacements. Also check NLB health checks — any steady 502s there?

eng-platform-sana: Running diagnostic commands now, logs show repeated cache eviction logs + OOM kill on one sidecar. Commands I'm running:
```
kubectl get pods -l app=embedding-service -n prod-usw2 -o wide
kubectl describe pod embedding-service-xyz -n prod-usw2
journalctl -u embedding-sidecar --since "10m" | grep -i eviction
```
I'll paste snippets if I find a smoking gun.

oncall-sre-jamie: Reroute applied. After 3m: error_rate -> 6% (1m window). Still seeing isolated 502s from pod embedding-service-xyz (node ip 10.3.44.12). Keeping the page open until stable for 15m.

incident-bot: Reminder: auto-escalation in 9m if incident state != resolved. PD link: <https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC1234567|INC1234567>.

support-ops-ryan: Drafting status note for affected customers: short explanation + mitigation steps. Will post to status.redwood.ai once Jamie confirms stable.

oncall-sre-jamie: Confirmed: kvcache churn is primary suspect; scaled pool and fallback route reduced customer impact. Keeping incident open for follow-up, will create postmortem if root cause is cache churn or quantized model memory pressure. If error rate climbs back above 8% I'll escalate.

ops-lead-matt: Thanks all. Follow up item for infra: audit cache sizing and autoscaler thresholds for embedding-service.

support-ops-ryan: Notifying top-5 affected customers now. Adding incident tags: embeddings, prod-usw2, 5xx, kvcache.

oncall-sre-jamie: Closing note: monitoring for 30m, leaving PD incident open for tracking. Re-ack or reopen thread if anything flares. :thumbsup:
